label: Necessary restriction determination boundary by truth-vector invariance (inference)
rule: Instantiate truth-vector invariance at the accessible absence witness
meaning: Necessary basis facts give the same complete selected evidence vector at actuality and the absence witness. EvidenceOnly transfers the actually true condition there; its determining clause contradicts the absence. CompleteTruthFixed directly excludes contingency. This is the fact-level application of the existing history-selection obstruction, not a new theorem that every adequate explanation must determine an outcome.
